nodes_add.name: Swami Vishvananda Saraswati
nodes_add.note: Dashanami (Saraswati) monk who gave Kuppuswami sannyasa and the name Sivananda at Rishikesh on 1 June 1924; by Krishnananda's account they met only briefly. Dates unknown.

nodes_add.name: Swami Chidananda
nodes_add.note: Sridhar Rao, born 24 September 1916; joined Sivananda 1943; sannyasa 10 July 1949; general secretary of the Divine Life Society from late 1948; president from August 1963; died 28 August 2008.

nodes_add.name: Swami Krishnananda
nodes_add.note: Subbaraya, born 25 April 1922; came to Sivananda 1944; sannyasa 14 January 1946; secretary for finance from 1957; general secretary of the Divine Life Society from 1961 until his death on 23 November 2001.

nodes_add.name: Swami Satchidananda
nodes_add.note: C. K. Ramaswamy, born 22 December 1914 near Coimbatore; sannyasa from Sivananda 1949; Integral Yoga in the US; opening address at Woodstock, August 1969; died Chennai 19 August 2002.

nodes_add.name: Swami Sivananda Radha
nodes_add.note: Ursula Sylvia Hellman, born Berlin 20 March 1911; sannyasa from Sivananda 1956; Yasodhara Ashram, Kootenay Bay, British Columbia (from 1963); died 30 November 1995.

nodes_add.name: Swami Venkatesananda
nodes_add.note: Disciple and biographer of Sivananda (Sivananda: Biography of a Modern Sage); later taught in South Africa and Australia (Fremantle).

nodes_update.name: Swami Sivananda
nodes_update.note: Kuppuswami, born Pattamadai 8 September 1887; doctor in Malaya c. 1913-1923; reached Rishikesh 1924 (DLS) or 1922 (Krishnananda); sannyasa from Vishvananda Saraswati, Rishikesh, 1 June 1924; Divine Life Society 1936; Yoga-Vedanta Forest Academy 1948; Yoga of Synthesis; died Rishikesh 14 July 1963.

nodes_update.name: Swami Vishnudevananda
nodes_update.note: Born Kerala 31 December 1927; came to Sivananda 1947 after reading a leaflet; first hatha yoga teacher at the Forest Academy; left for the West 1957; first Sivananda Yoga Vedanta Centre, Montreal, 1959; died 9 November 1993.

edges_upsert.note: Sannyasa at Rishikesh, 1 June 1924; viraja homa performed by Swami Vishnudevananda, mahant of Kailas Ashram (not the later disciple)
Saraswati branch of the Dashanami order through Vishvananda Saraswati; Advaita as his philosophy
Taught hatha yoga (asana, pranayama, kundalini) in books such as The Science of Pranayama (1935); hatha as one strand of the Yoga of Synthesis
Came to the ashram 1943; sannyasa 12 September 1947; left 1956; Bihar School of Yoga, Munger, 1964

Joined 1947 after reading Sivananda's leaflet on spiritual instructions; sannyasa at the ashram (year given as 1947 by SYVC, not independently confirmed); first hatha yoga professor at the Forest Academy; sent West 1957; Montreal centre 1959
Joined 1943; sannyasa on Guru Purnima, 10 July 1949; successor as president of the Divine Life Society, 1963
Came 1944; sannyasa 14 January 1946; long-serving general secretary of the Divine Life Society
Sannyasa 1949 at Rishikesh; founded Integral Yoga in the US
Sylvia Hellman; sannyasa 1956; described by her ashram as the first Western woman sannyasin (organisation's claim)
Disciple at the Rishikesh ashram and author of the society's biography of Sivananda; sannyasa date not checked

places.name: Seremban, Malaya

places.name: Swarg Ashram, Rishikesh
places.what: Years of austerity and nursing sick sadhus after sannyasa in 1924

places.name: Sivanandanagar (Muni ki Reti), Rishikesh
places.what: Ashram from 1932; Divine Life Society 1936; died here 14 July 1963

glossary.def: The fire offering at the heart of the sannyasa rite, in which the candidate symbolically gives his past life and desires to the fire before taking the ochre robe.
Group singing of divine names and short hymns, usually in call and response.
The period before dawn, traditionally about an hour and a half before sunrise, held to be the best time for prayer and meditation.

Sivananda's name for his method: one main path (service, devotion, knowledge or meditation) practised daily with smaller amounts of the others and some hatha yoga, so that head, heart and hand develop together.
In yogic and Ayurvedic physiology, a subtle vital essence said to be built up by conserving sexual energy; not a concept of modern medicine.

issues: src/content/figures/sivananda.mdx: date of arrival in Rishikesh conflicts. DLS gives 8 May 1924; Swami Krishnananda's 1972 talk (dlshq.org/?p=1900) says 1922. Both given in the text.

src/content/figures/sivananda.mdx: medical qualification. DLS biography says he earned 'M.B., C.M.' at Tanjore; this could not be independently confirmed and is attributed to the society. Some popular accounts describe a lesser diploma; not checked.

src/content/figures/sivananda.mdx: the 8 January 1950 attack is told only from Sivananda's own essay (assailant 'half-demented', 'bowed to him, worshipped him and sent him home'). Popular retellings add an axe and the attacker's name; not verified, so left out.

src/content/figures/sivananda.mdx: 'Swami Propagandananda' nickname is cited by Wikipedia to Goldberg 2016, pp. 326-335 and Van Lysebeth 1981; Goldberg not seen directly. Van Lysebeth quotes are taken from Wikipedia's quotation of his 1981 Yoga article; the original was not seen.
src/content/figures/sivananda.mdx: number of books given as 'over 200' (Wikipedia) and 'more than 300' (DLS). Left as a range.

src/content/figures/sivananda.mdx: Krishnananda's start as general secretary is 1958 (Wikipedia via Sivananda article) or 1961 (swami-krishnananda.org). Both given. Chidananda was general secretary from late 1948 per DLS.
src/content/figures/sivananda.mdx: first Sivananda Yoga Vedanta Centre in Montreal dated 1957 by SYVC (Google Arts & Culture) and 1959 by Wikipedia. Both given.

src/content/figures/sivananda.mdx: Critiques uses McKean (1996) only through the University of Chicago Press summary and table of contents; the chapters themselves were not read. The checker may want a page-level citation.
src/content/figures/sivananda.mdx: 'Practice of Brahmacharya' quotation taken from an OCOY reprint (ocoy.org); the DLS edition (dlshq.org/?p=2627) was not fetched to confirm wording.

src/content/figures/sivananda.mdx: the YouTube film (RcA3wptRWrc) and the podcast kirtan recordings are linked via Integral Yoga Magazine and Apple Podcasts listings; dates and provenance of the original recordings are not stated anywhere seen. The podcast's copyright line names Yoga Vidya.

sivananda: Born Kuppuswami 8 Sept 1887 Pattamadai; parents P.S. Vengu Iyer (revenue officer, Shiva devotee) and Parvati Ammal; third and last son; Rajah's High School Ettayapuram; SPG College Trichy; Tanjore medical school, M.B., C.M.; Ambrosia with Rs 100 from mother; 1913 S.S. Tara to Singapore; Seremban, Dr Harold Parsons, A.G. Robins estate hospital; renounced 1923; Benares, Dhalaj, postmaster; Rishikesh 8 May 1924; sannyasa 1 June 1924 from Visvananda Saraswati; viraja homa by Vishnudevananda of Kailas Ashram; Swargashram; dispensary 1927 at Lakshmanjula from insurance policy; DLS 1936 registered trust; Divine Life journal Sept 1938; Akhanda Mahamantra Kirtan 3 Dec 1943; pharmacy 1945; All-world Religions Federation 28 Dec 1945; Sadhus Federation 19 Feb 1947; Forest Academy 1948; 1950 India and Ceylon tour; press 1951; World Parliament of Religions 1953; eye hospital 1957; visited Ramana Ashram, Aurobindo Ashram, Kailas-Manasarovar; died 14 July 1963 in Kutir; 'more than three hundred' books -> https://www.dlshq.org/?p=1883
DLS 1936; Forest Academy 1948; 'over 300 books'; slogan 'Serve, Love, Give, Purify, Meditate, Realise' -> https://www.dlshq.org/?p=2711

Brahmin family; 'over 200 books'; 'Be Good, do Good'; 'meat-eating is highly deleterious to health'; Van Lysebeth quotes: critics 'disapproved of both his modern methods of diffusion and his propagation of yoga on such a grand scale to the general public'; 'some asanas, a little pranayama, a little meditation and bhakti; well, a little of everything'; nickname 'Swami Propagandananda' (Goldberg 2016 pp. 326-335); disciples list incl. Jyotirmayananda, Sahajananda, Venkatesananda -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sivananda_Saraswati

Autobiography (DLS 6th ed. 1995, WWW ed. 2000): 'I learnt fencing from a teacher who belonged to a low caste' (p. vi); told unbecoming for caste-Brahmin; afraid of non-vegetarian food on ship (p. 4); 'I gave up the life of ease, comfort and luxury' (p. 7); 8 January 1950 'the Lord came to me in the form of a half-demented assailant, who disturbed the night Satsang at the Ashram'; 'bowed to him, worshipped him and sent him home' (p. vii); 'One coalesced into the next, and the Yoga of Synthesis was the fruit' (p. vii); introduction notes no account of why he left Malaya -> https://ia802302.us.archive.org/26/items/autobiography_202108/autobiography.pdf

'How God Came into My Life': father's ceremonial worship; 'child-mind'; 'Then in Malaya, God came to me in the form of the sick'; 'as a single event'; 'This drew me from Malaya to the Himalaya' -> https://sivanandabahamas.org/how-god-came-into-my-life-by-swami-sivananda/

Krishnananda talk 1 June 1972: arrived Rishikesh 1922; Jnana sannyasa 1924 after a few minutes; dry bread and Ganga water; sandbank across Laxmanjhula; 'Tapas is burning like fire by sense-control'; Hari Ganesh Ambekar Re 1 per month; medicine and curd for dysentery; Satya Sevasrama; 'God-realisation first, everything else afterwards' -> https://www.dlshq.org/?p=1900

Kutir 'infested with scorpions'; served sick sadhus; 1932 ashram on right bank; old kutir 'looked like an abandoned cowshed'; Appayya Dikshitar ancestor -> https://divyajivan.org/sivananda/sivananda.htm
Toured from early 1930s; Sivananda Ashram 1932; DLS 1936; Forest Academy 1948 -> https://artsandculture.google.com/story/rwVhKBVYlxFhKA
Never left the shores of India (read as never went West; he did go to Malaya and Ceylon) -> https://biharyoga.net/swami-sivananda.php

Yoga of Synthesis: 'tricycle or a three-wheeled chariot'; 'One-sided development is not commendable'; 'head, heart and hand'; 'one Yoga as the basic Yoga and combine other Yogas'; 'A little practice of Hatha Yoga' -> https://www.dlshq.org/?p=1765

Twenty instructions: 'Get up at 4 a.m. daily'; '108 times to 21,600 times daily'; Ekadasi fast; 'Mouna ... for a couple of hours daily'; 'Keep a daily spiritual diary and self-correction register as Benjamin Franklin did'; 'This is the essence of all spiritual Sadhana. It will lead you to liberation.' -> https://www.dlshq.org/?p=1740

'Bear insult: bear injury: this is the highest Sadhana'; 'adapt, adjust and accommodate'; 'The aim of Sadhana is the curbing of the ego which veils the Truth' (Yoga Samhita) -> https://www.dlshq.org/?p=1364
Song of Eighteen Ities: pick one virtue, develop it, remove its opposite -> https://divyajivan.org/sivananda/eighteen%20ities.htm
Practice of Yoga vol. 1, Ganesh & Co., Madras, 1929 -> https://tamildigitallibrary.in/ (record TVA_BOK_0034076)
Science of Pranayama first edition 1935 -> https://www.dlshq.org/?p=2701
'The preservation of semen is the secret of health and longevity'; seminal energy stored as ojas -> https://ocoy.org/monastic-life/practice-of-brahmacharya/chapter-eight-glory-brahmacharya/
Strauss: 'trained as a secular medical doctor in south India'; Expedition 46:3, 2004 -> https://www.penn.museum/sites/expedition/?p=8855
Strauss, Positioning Yoga (Berg 2005); Newcombe: links 'Serve, Love, Meditate, Realise' to Vivekananda's four paths -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Positioning_Yoga
McKean 1996, chs. 7-9 on Sivananda and DLS; 'participation by upper-caste ruling class groups in the Divine Life Society' -> https://chicagoreference.com/ucp/books/book/chicago/D/bo3627043.html
Goldberg 2016: yoga's shift toward health and fitness among middle-class Indians -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sivananda_yoga
Kirtan recordings 'Historical recording of Swami Sivananda' -> https://podcasts.apple.com/podcast/id428952840
Video 'You are the Master of Your Destiny' with his voice and footage -> https://integralyogamagazine.org/celebrating-the-135th-birth-anniversary-of-h-h-sri-swami-sivananda
Pattamadai coordinates 8.664167 N, 77.582222 E -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pattamadai
